next_step: Closed-lost (chose hyperscaler managed endpoints). Re-engage in 6-9 months with migration playbook and reseller/partner discounts.
notes:
Status: closed-lost to AWS SageMaker managed endpoints. Short notes from deal:
- May 10: Intro call. CTO Mark Li outlined heavy latency SLOs (p95 50-150ms for chat) and strict residency/KMS needs.
- May-June: 2-week POC on Dedicated; Redwood met latency targets, prefix caching looked promising.
- Jun 12: Security call (ff_2024-06-12) — security asks: HSM/KMS integration timeline, SOC2 evidence, audit log retention details.
- Jul: Procurement requested side-by-side cost/ops comparison vs hyperscaler managed endpoints. They have significant AWS discounts via enterprise agreement.
- Jul 09: Security requested formal HSM/KMS architecture doc (ff_2024-07-09). We committed to private deployment timetable (Q4 earliest for HSM).
- Aug: Internal champion (Sr ML Eng) left company mid-July; momentum slowed. Procurement committee voted to consolidate on native cloud endpoints to simplify billing/ops.
- Aug 20: Final procurement decision: select AWS SageMaker Managed Endpoints. Procurement cited consolidated billing, internal team familiarity, and no immediate ramp for HSM integration.
- Sep: Deal marked closed-lost. Action: flag for 6-9 month winback, share migration playbook, offer partner credits if re-engage.
Quotes: "We like Redwood's performance but consolidating on AWS removes vendor sprawl — finance wants a single cloud stack." — CTO Mark Li.
POC result snippet: dedicated nodes hit latency SLOs, estimated cost 20% higher than internal hyperscaler pricing after enterprise discounts.
Notes on stakeholders: CTO Mark Li (technical sponsor), Sr ML Eng (initial champion, left 2024-07), Head of Procurement Rachel Moreno (final sign-off). Security lead: Omar Khalid (requested HSM requirement).
Key risks for re-engage: need to demonstrate cost delta after discounts, speed up HSM/KMS roadmap, offer plug-and-play migration with minimal ops overhead.
timeline: 2024-06-20: Dedicated POC deployed — perf baseline collected
2024-08-15: Procurement comparison requested — Redwood vs AWS/Azure
2024-08-20: Procurement committee selects AWS SageMaker managed endpoints
loss_reason: Consolidation onto hyperscaler managed endpoints (AWS SageMaker) due to existing discounts, unified billing, and lower short-term ops friction. Additional factors: internal champion left and HSM/KMS integration timeline longer than customer's procurement window.
